subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

My brother / had being / cracking jokes.
solution:
"The correct answer is **'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "My brother / had being / cracking jokes." contains a grammatical error.
 
• The error lies in the phrase "had being". In this context, the correct phrase should be "had been" to indicate the past perfect continuous tense.
 
• Therefore, option 2, "had being" is the part of the sentence that contains the error.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "My brother" This option is correct as it appropriately specifies the subject of the sentence.
 
• Option 3: "No error" This option isn't correct as the sentence contains a grammatical error.
 
• Option 4: "cracking jokes" This part of the sentence is also correct and does not contain any errors.
